newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones rose by 22.73 points to 5,904.90. PLDT's ADR inched up by $ 1/2 to $63.
* The peso closed at 26.242 to a U.S.dollar from 26.236.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,189.98, up 20.20 points.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate rises to 12.15625 percent from 11.96875.

* Manila Bulletin quoted a source as saying Liberty Holdings Inc has estimated its revenue to reach one billion pesos in 1997 with its subscriber base increasing to 4,838 for Versaphone and 1,200 subscribers for Liberty Skyphone.

* Manila Bulletin said Guoco Holdings Inc had informed the Securities and Exchange Commission that it, along with a group of foreign investors, was making an indirect equity investment in a prospective paging service operator.
* A Reuter poll on Tuesday showed a majority of analysts expected September inflation to fall below 5.5 percent, down from 7.9 percent in August.

* A Reuter poll on Tuesday showed analysts were expecting Manila Electric Co (Meralco) to generate profits of close to 4.0 billion pesos for the first nine months of 1996 from 3.34 billion pesos in the same period in 1995.

* A Reuter poll on Tuesday showed Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co (Metrobank) was expected to post a nine-month net profit of 3.308 billion pesos, 45 percent higher than the year-ago figure of 2.28 billion pesos.
